sections.title: Directed Reading in Physics and Astronomy
sections.description: The Physics Directed Reading Program (DRP) pairs undergraduate students with graduate student mentors and a faculty supervisor for a semester-long independent study. The DRP encourages undergraduates to explore a topic in physics that they might not encounter in a traditional classroom setting and involves about 4 hours per week of independent study. In addition to hour-long weekly meetings with their mentor, undergraduates will present their work at the end of the semester.  Mid-semester events focused on developing research related skills will also be offered
